newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: BB Industrie sells Acerinox stake.
newsitem.headline: BB Industrie sells Acerinox stake.

text.p: Swiss financial holding company BB Industrie said it had sold its 2.2 percent stake in Spanish steel company Acerinox.

"BB Industrie has sold its stake in Spanish company Acerinox, one of Europe's leading producers of stainless steel, in recent days," it said in a statement. It did not identify the buyers or give other financial details.
A company spokesman said the shares were sold in the market over the past few weeks.

BB said it held 260,000 Acerinox shares at the end of 1996, or a stake of around 2.2 percent worth 50 million Swiss francs. It said it made a profit of nearly 12 million francs after Acerinox shares rose around 70 percent since early 1996.

"This is a further step for BB in its concentration on the two core stakes of more than 30 percent each in Saurer and Rieter," it said, adding the market was underestimating their potential profit gains. BB had investment funds worth 730 million francs as of today, it said.
